## About
Frisco Lawn & Power Equipment is a lawn and landscape power equipment dealer, parts store and repair shop on Main St in Frisco. We carry gas and electric equipment for homeowners and for the professional landscapers who keep this area mowed and trimmed.
We service what we sell. Your new equipment is assembled and tested before you leave, we register it with the manufacturer, and any warranty work is done right here instead of being shipped off. Owners Perry and Gay Lee Prindle want every customer to get straight answers about their equipment and how to take care of it.
Come by the shop or give us a call. We're rated 4.3 on Google from 213 reviews.

## Services
- Toro, Honda, Scag, Echo, Stihl and Billy Goat equipment: Gas powered lawn and garden equipment from the brands we carry, plus Stihl and Echo electric equipment.
- Zero turn mowers: Zero turn mowers from Toro, Scag and Stihl, in stock and ready for delivery.
- Honda generators: We are a full service Honda generator dealer, and our staff can help you choose the right type and wattage for what you need.
- Blade sharpen and oil change package: Blade sharpen and oil change for walk mowers, available year round. ($39.00 + tax)
- 13-point walk mower maintenance: Blade sharpening, oil change, new spark plug and air filter, fuel system flush, cable lube, belt and drive check, and a pressure wash including under the deck. ($120.00 + tax)
- 8-point hand held and 2-cycle equipment maintenance: For Stihl, Echo and Shindaiwa hand held equipment: new spark plug, air and fuel filters, fuel system flush, linkage lube, spark arrestor cleaning and a pressure wash. ($80.00 + tax)
- 20-point zero turn mower maintenance: For Scag, Toro and Stihl zero turn mowers, including blade balancing, oil and filters, battery test, brake check, deck leveling and a pressure wash. Appointment required. (Approx. $350.00 - $450.00 + tax)
- Engine service and repair: For mowing equipment with a name brand engine such as Briggs & Stratton, Honda, Kohler or Kawasaki. Won't start, running rough, broken recoil starter, blowing smoke and more.
- Sharpening: Mower blades, chainsaw blades, hedge trimmers, and manual trimmers, clippers and loppers.
- Pick-up and delivery for riding and zero turn mowers: We can pick up your riding or zero turn mower and bring it back when the work is done. Call to schedule. ($170.00)

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for riding mower service?
A: Yes. Riding mowers and zero turn mowers need an appointment. Please call the shop to set one up.

Q: What does it cost to fix a mower that won't start or runs rough?
A: For walk mowers, hand held equipment and pressure washers that are running rough, not starting, hard to start or surging, repairs typically cost between $140 and $190, with a $45.00 or $85.00 deposit.

Q: When is the best time to bring in my riding mower?
A: Fall or winter. Getting riding mower work done then helps you avoid the spring rush and delays.

Q: Do you sell used equipment?
A: During the winter months, November through February, we have pre-owned lawn care equipment from various brands.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Frisco, Plano, Allen, McKinney, Prosper, Celina, Little Elm, The Colony and surrounding areas.

Q: Why can't I get through on the phone?
A: During the busy part of the season, especially on Saturdays, we may have trouble answering every call. Coming by the shop is usually the quickest way to get help.
